name: Camera Look-at Computation via Rotation
definition: Computes a camera look-at point by taking a forward vector, rotating it around the camera's X and Z axes using spherical coordinates, and adding it to the camera position.
summary: Camera Look-at Computation via Rotation derives a camera view matrix from spherical angles or position and direction, distinguishing itself by using explicit Euler angles or direct vector construction instead of quaternion interpolation.
